suppress.notes: Case (i), verified false positive. CVE-2026-53914 is in KAPT's incremental cache (kapt-base), shipped only in KAPT artifacts. These are the Kotlin standard library, reflection and script runtime, which contain no KAPT code. They sit on build-tool classpaths: detekt 1.23.8 (2.0.21, and the 1.8.0 stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 shims), ktlint 1.8.0 (2.2.21), Android lint 32.4.1 (2.2.10), and the 1.6.10 kotlin-reflect that JetBrains pins inside its own 2.4.20 compiler. Published artifacts depend on kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20.

Case (i), verified false positive. CVE-2026-53914 is in KAPT's incremental cache (kapt-base). The embedded compiler and daemon jars below contain no org/jetbrains/kotlin/kapt/base/incremental classes. They are the compilers that detekt 1.23.8 (2.0.21) and ktlint 1.8.0 (2.2.21) use to parse sources. Neither tool can take a Kotlin 2.4.20 floor: detekt rejects any compiler other than the one it was built with, and ktlint 1.8.0 fails on 2.4.20 with "Extensions storage is not registered". detekt 2.0.0-alpha.6 embeds 2.4.10, still below the fix line, and ktlint 2.0.0-ALPHA-4 embeds 2.4.0.

Case (i), verified false positive. These are Dokka 2.2.0 jars, not Kotlin jars. The match is a low-confidence guess, cpe:...:jetbrains:kotlin:2.2.0, from Dokka's own version number. analysis-kotlin-symbols embeds the Kotlin Analysis API, but no KAPT code: no org/jetbrains/kotlin/kapt/base/incremental classes in any of these jars. Dokka 2.2.0 is the newest stable release. Dokka's separate kotlin-stdlib and kotlin-reflect dependencies are already floored to 2.4.20 in build.gradle.kts.

Case (i), verified false positive. CVE-2012-2055 is a mass-assignment flaw in GitHub Enterprise before 2012-03-04 (cpe:...:github:github). It matched because kotlin-logging's group is io.github.oshai and its POM names "github" as the developer organisation, so version 8.0.4 was read as a GitHub version. The AAR contains classes.jar, a manifest and R.txt: a logging facade with no GitHub code.

Case (i), verified false positive. CVE-2008-0986 is an integer overflow in BMP::readFromStream in the native libsgl.so of the 2008 Android SDK (m3-rc37a, m5-rc14). It matched AGP's analytics protobuf messages through a low-confidence android_sdk:32.4.1 CPE guess. The jar holds 4,332 generated protobuf classes (com/google/wireless/android/sdk/stats) and no native library or image decoder. It is on the androidLintTool classpath only.

Case (ii), no upstream fix, build-time only. CVE-2026-56740 and CVE-2026-56741 are resource-exhaustion flaws in JLine's telnet server (TelnetIO, remote-telnet module), fixed in 3.30.14. The classes really are in the jar (org/jline/builtins/telnet/TelnetIO.class), but they are reachable only if something starts a JLine telnet server. Android lint uses the compiler to analyse this project's sources and opens no listener. No lint release, stable or pre-release, ships a fixed jline yet. Re-check the newest AGP when this expires.

Case (ii), no upstream fix, build-time only. CVE-2022-3171 (GC-pause DoS) and CVE-2024-7254 (stack overflow on nested groups) need a parser fed hostile protobuf input. The jar holds no com/google/protobuf classes, only Kotlin's relocated 2.6.1 fork (277 classes under org/jetbrains/kotlin/protobuf), which lint uses to read Kotlin metadata from this build's own classes and its pinned dependencies. No lint release, stable or pre-release, ships a newer copy. Re-check the newest AGP when this expires.
